summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K disclosing two exchange agreements with Streeterville Capital on May 21, 2026, in which the company issued 54,222 common shares in exchange for 7.96 shares of Series Q Perpetual Preferred Stock. The exchanged preferred shares were cancelled and retired. No price per share, premium, or board recommendation was stated. The filing also notes an adjourned annual meeting for supplemental proxy information. This is a capital return via preferred-to-common exchange, reducing preferred overhang. Watch for potential dilution impact and Nasdaq listing implications.
